title: Example: SQL injection in search parameter
description: The search endpoint reflects user input into a SQL query without parameterization.
recommendation: Use parameterized queries or an ORM; validate and encode all inputs.
backgroundInformation: Discovered during authenticated testing of the reporting module.
impactDescription: Full read access to the application database.
likelihoodDescription: Exploitable with a normal user account.

evidences.Title: SQL error screenshot
evidences.IssueDetails: SQL exception text is reflected in response.
evidences.Reproduce:
1. Authenticate to the app.
2. Browse to Reports search.
3. Submit test' in q parameter.
evidences.Evidence: See attached screenshot and request artifact.
